basics.name: Roger Vilà
basics.label: Software Architect
basics.summary: Software architect with 13 years of professional experience. Architected a 10+ service, event-driven platform on Kubernetes for HP, and now modernise legacy Java and PHP SaaS APIs on AWS and Cloudflare at InfoPro Digital Automotive. Builds secure REST APIs and event-driven integrations (Apache Pulsar, AWS SQS), implements observability (Grafana, Datadog, ELK Stack) and manages incident response. Former founder of a web development company and startup tech lead who took a restaurant product from scratch to an MVP launched for investors.

work.name: InfoPro Digital Automotive
work.description: Main B2B platform for car parts distributors in the Spanish market
highlights: Reduced production incidents by 20% through systematic refactoring, stronger test coverage and safer deployment practices.

Modernise legacy Java and PHP SaaS APIs on AWS and Cloudflare that integrate data from multiple providers; chose Cloudflare edge caching over scaling the AWS origin because traffic was mostly read-heavy lookups, which cut origin load and cost.
Manage incident response: severity-based triage, resolution estimates and structured postmortems to drive long-term reliability improvements.
Mentor junior developers through code reviews and shared backend engineering practices.

work.name: Wivapp.com
highlights: Led development of a new restaurant product from scratch, built with Laravel, Inertia.js and React on DigitalOcean Kubernetes.
Chose a modular monolith over microservices to deliver the MVP in 3 months, then launched it to present the product to investors.
Stepped down when the venture did not move past the investor stage.

work.name: Convelio
highlights: Designed and maintained secure PHP APIs for a high-volume logistics platform serving 1,000+ clients per week, meeting its availability SLA.
Improved API performance and reliability, cutting response times by 200–500 ms per request; implemented observability with Grafana, Datadog and the ELK Stack.

Centralised the API contract in the OpenAPI Specification (formerly known as Swagger) so multiple frontends consumed one backend API; OpenAPI contract tests let frontend and backend teams evolve independently without breaking changes.
Removed 10,000+ lines of dead and unsafe legacy code, improving security, performance and maintainability.
Raised code quality through automated testing and peer code reviews.

work.name: HP
highlights: Architected and operated a distributed platform of 10+ Docker-based microservices on Kubernetes in production, processing data from 3,000+ high-value customers that fed business-critical automated decisions.

Designed event-driven integrations with Apache Pulsar, AWS SQS and Redis Pub/Sub to decouple services for scalability and fault tolerance; chose AWS SQS over self-hosted RabbitMQ for cloud workloads because a managed queue removed broker operations from a small team.
Built secure API integrations and background processing in Laravel, and data pipelines and robotic process automation (RPA) in Python.
Built and maintained Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with SonarQube quality checks, reaching 80% code coverage across the platform.
Led remote engineering teams across Europe and Asia, running architecture reviews, code reviews and technical mentorship.

work.name: Health Dataline Europe SA
work.summary: Rebuilt the mobile front end of 10+ client eCommerce sites and built internal data APIs.
highlights: Rebuilt the front end of 10+ client eCommerce websites for mobile devices with Onsen UI.
Built internal APIs that retrieve data from multiple backend sources.

work.name: SeeDoCare S.L.
work.description: Run in parallel with employed roles
work.summary: Founded and ran a web development company in parallel with employed roles; won 3 clients in year one.
highlights: Founded and ran a web development company; won 3 clients in the first year and delivered custom eCommerce, SaaS and CMS solutions at 20% lower cost than competing B2B platforms.
Expanded the offer with SEO, brand design and marketing services.
Closed the company in 2017 and moved to full-time employment.

work.name: Emotion Experience
work.summary: Built interactive brand installations for GFT, including the GFT Lab, driving LED displays and interactive panels.
highlights: Built interactive brand experiences for GFT, with custom software for LED displays and interactive panels.
Developed the software for the "GFT Lab" installation.

work.name: Caravelo
work.summary: Built Volado Volaris, a last-minute fare product for Volaris airline, and a design system used by 2 new airlines.
highlights: Built "Volado Volaris", a product selling last-minute fares for empty seats on Volaris flights; shipped the first release in 1 month.
Created a design system to integrate new airlines into the company's products; 2 new airlines used it.
Maintained product websites for airline customers.

work.name: SIQUR S.P.A.
work.summary: Built the Spanish eCommerce site and a content blog; ran SEO, analytics and campaigns.
highlights: Built the Spanish version of the company's eCommerce website.
Launched a WordPress blog for content marketing and ran SEO, analytics and marketing campaigns.

work.name: CIPSA
work.summary: Taught full-stack web development to 50+ students; more than half found a job after the course.
highlights: Hired as an instructor after completing the school's Web Development Master programme.
Taught full-stack web development to 50+ students, from a first HTML page to a final full-stack project.
More than 50% of students found a job after finishing the course.

work.name: Mediterrani Food
work.summary: Built the company website and content marketing that brought in 10+ new clients.
highlights: Built and maintained the company's WordPress website and applied the brand design across web, reports and communications.
Wrote blog posts, edited videos, managed the community and ran SEO; this content brought in 10+ new clients.
